points.title: 出生与早年生活
points.description: 西贝柳斯于1865年12月8日出生于芬兰海门林纳。他的家庭环境对他的音乐生涯有着深远的影响。在这里，他接受了早期的音乐教育，并开始创作自己的音乐作品。海门林纳为他提供了一个宁静的环境，让他能够专注于音乐创作。
points.descriptionEn: Jean Sibelius was born on December 8, 1865, in Hameenlinna, Finland. His family environment had a profound impact on his musical career. Here, he received his early musical education and began to compose his own musical works. Hameenlinna provided a tranquil environment where he could focus on musical composition.

points.title: 音乐教育与早期创作
points.description: 1885年，西贝柳斯前往赫尔辛基，进入音乐学院学习。在这里，他接受了系统的音乐教育，并开始创作自己的交响乐作品。这一时期，他的音乐风格开始形成，受到了芬兰民族主义的影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1885, Sibelius moved to Helsinki to study at the music academy. Here, he received systematic musical education and began to compose his own symphonic works. During this period, his musical style began to take shape, influenced by Finnish nationalism.

points.title: 交响乐创作高峰
points.description: 在这一时期，西贝柳斯创作了多部著名的交响乐作品，包括《芬兰颂》和《Karelia》组曲。这些作品使他在国际上获得了认可，并确立了他在芬兰音乐史上的地位。
points.descriptionEn: During this period, Sibelius composed several famous symphonic works, including the 'Finlandia' and the 'Karelia' Suite. These works brought him international recognition and established his place in Finnish musical history.

points.title: 晚年创作与影响
points.titleEn: Later Years of Composition and Influence
points.description: 晚年的西贝柳斯继续创作，尽管他的创作量有所减少。他的音乐风格逐渐转向简约，但他仍然创作了一些重要的作品。他的音乐对芬兰乃至整个世界音乐产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Sibelius continued to compose, although his output decreased. His musical style gradually turned towards simplicity, but he still produced some important works. His music had a profound influence on Finnish and world music.

points.title: 逝世
points.description: 西贝柳斯于1957年9月20日在赫尔辛基逝世。他的音乐遗产继续影响着后世，成为芬兰乃至世界音乐的重要组成部分。
points.descriptionEn: Jean Sibelius died on September 20, 1957, in Helsinki. His musical legacy continues to influence posterity, becoming an important part of Finnish and world music.

supporter.zh: 西贝柳斯被视为芬兰音乐的象征，他的作品被认为是芬兰民族精神的体现。他的音乐具有强烈的民族特色，对芬兰音乐的发展产生了深远的影响。
supporter.en: Sibelius is seen as the symbol of Finnish music, with his works considered as the embodiment of the Finnish national spirit. His music has a strong national character and has had a profound impact on the development of Finnish music.

critic.zh: 一些批评者认为西贝柳斯的音乐风格过于单一，缺乏创新。他的后期作品被认为过于简约，缺乏深度。
critic.en: Some critics argue that Sibelius's musical style is too monotonous and lacks innovation. His later works are considered too simplistic and lacking in depth.

objective.zh: 西贝柳斯是芬兰民族主义音乐的代表人物，他的音乐作品在芬兰乃至世界音乐史上占有重要地位。他的音乐风格独特，对后世音乐家产生了深远的影响。
objective.en: Sibelius is a representative figure of Finnish nationalist music, and his musical works occupy an important place in the history of Finnish and world music. His musical style is unique and has had a profound influence on later musicians.

self.zh: 音乐是我的生命，我的灵魂。
self.en: Music is my life, my soul.

others.zh: 西贝柳斯的音乐是芬兰的骄傲，他的作品将永远流传。
others.en: Sibelius's music is the pride of Finland, and his works will be passed down forever.
